source_metadata.source: India Meteorological Department gridded daily rainfall (0.25 degree)
source_metadata.boundary_license: Open Data Commons Open Database License 1.0
source_metadata.aggregation: unweighted mean of valid grid-cell-centre values inside each district polygon; if covered cells contain no valid data in a file, average valid values among the eight nearest grid centres to its representative point
source_metadata.unit: mm (variable units read from each NetCDF file)
limitations: coastal districts have partial grid-cell coverage
aggregation is a district mean and cannot substitute for station maxima

interpretation: Empirical district daily rainfall values grouped by calendar month; values are not forecast-calibrated.
